C0318.title: Tang XX Used 'Changyou Registration Bot' for Mass Game Account Creation
C0318.summary: In October 2018, Lanxi Court ruled on the first malicious account-registration case. The defendant created and sold 'Changyou Registration Bot.exe', which could automatically generate registration information, obtain phone numbers and verification codes through a third-party platform, and submit data packets to Changyou's registration servers to complete bulk account creation. The court found that the tool interfered with the platform's normal process, treated it as a destructive program, and imposed criminal punishment for providing programs or tools for intrusion or illegal control of computer information systems.
